actual_current_PR.body:
Completes the contributor-workflow evaluation and corrects the native Work/Docs qualification harness. Phase 0/M0 is closed with all five issues complete. Phase 1 remains open; this PR remains a draft until a complete native run and final independent acceptance review pass.

The current pushed head is `dd0e8c0ce8d1d00f15de6b07e2e26d368c5c3774`. The latest correction tests a missing contributor binding at each real boundary: the result watch must reject, a contributor poke must leave protected state unchanged, and the native final transition must return the explicit authorization denial. Binding restoration and its full state comparison run even when the probe fails. No Hoon implementation, authorization policy or thermal limit changed.

Validation at that source:

- All 476 host/static/mocked tests passed; these do not establish native correctness.
- A fresh 58-check native Gall schedule passed, including the delayed old-leave case and deliberately failing control; independent review cleared that bounded obligation.
- Seven nonnative dispositions were refreshed and independently audited. They do not substitute for the 66 native requirements.
- Full core06 ran for 1,159.787 seconds, recorded 313 passing direct checks and 145 QA passes plus three frozen deferrals, then stopped when the unchanged thermal guard sampled 92 C. No failed assertion was recorded before interruption; the remaining native lanes were not reached. This failed lifetime does not qualify Phase 1.

The previous capacity01 diagnostic verified five malformed-predecessor rejections and valid 4,096-event migration, then failed the missing-binding test expectation corrected here. All failed attempts and their exact source bindings are retained separately. No partial prefixes are combined into a passing run.

The newest native/host/review records and updated closeout notes are currently retained locally for the final evidence commit; published historical records retain their original source identities. The temporary desktop widget pause after core06 was restored and verified; no automated browser quota was applied.

Remaining before integration: complete the full current core run, derive and independently review all 73 acceptance rows, publish the exact evidence, and review the final aggregate against main. Earlier stacked PRs remain preserved and will be reconciled only after that gate. No GitHub CI or human approval is claimed. Phase 2 has not started.
